html.body: Date: 2025-04-23 REMARKSClaims 1-10 are pending in the application. Claims 1-10 are rejected under 35 U.S.C.§102(a)(2) for allegedly being anticipated by WO 2023/129648 to Luo. Reconsideration is respectfully requested in view of the remarks and amendments submitted herewith.Summary of Examiner Interview The undersigned thanks Primary Examiner Huynh for the interview of April 14, 2025. The specification, claims, and drawings of the instant application were discussed in view of the 35 U.S.C. §102(a)(2) rejections in view of Luo. A tentative agreement was reached regarding the original claims overcoming the current rejections. However, the Examiner indicated that an updated search and consideration would be required.Entry of this statement of substance of interview is requested as the statement is in compliance with 37 CFR 1.133.Rejections under 35 U.S.C. §102(a)(2) As noted hereinabove, claims 1-10 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. §102(a)(2) for allegedly being anticipated by Luo. The rejections are respectfully traversed.For a prior art reference to anticipate a claim, "the identical invention must be shown [in the prior art reference] in as complete detail as is contained in the claim." See MPEP 2131 (quoting Richardson v. Suzuki Motor Co., 868 F.2d 1226, 1236 (Fed. Cir. 1989)). A claim may be anticipated by a prior art reference "only if each and every element as set forth in the claim is found, either expressly or inherently described, in a single prior art reference." Id. (quoting VerdegaalBros. v. Union Oil Co. of California, 814 F.2d 628, 631 (Fed. Cir. 1987)).As tentatively agreed to during the telephone interview, Applicant respectfully submits that Luo fails to expressly or inherently disclose or make obvious the features of original independent claims 1 and 9. Specifically, the cited art fails to expressly or inherently disclose or make obvious the features of original independent claims 1 and 9 regarding the driver-assistance system is configured to convert the respective local lane data into respective global lane data dependent on respective GNSS data of the vehicle generated by the GNSS receiver when driving on the respective segment and to save the respective global lane data, and the respective global lane data specifies the respective course of the lane on the respective segment in global coordinates.In view of the foregoing, Applicant respectfully submits that independent claims 1 and 9, and all claims that depend thereon, are not anticipated or obvious in view of Luo. Therefore, Applicant respectfully submits that independent claims 1 and 9 are patentable over Luo. Applicant respectfully requests that the rejections be withdrawn and independent claims 1 and 9, and all claims that depend thereon, be held in a condition for allowance.Conclusion In view of the above amendments and remarks, Applicant respectfully submits that the application is now in condition for allowance. The Examiner is encouraged to contact the undersigned to resolve efficiently any formal matters or to discuss any aspects of the application or of this response. Otherwise, early notification of allowable subject matter is respectfully requested.The Director is hereby authorized to charge any deficiency in the fees filed, asserted to be filed or which should have been filed herewith (or with any paper hereafter filed in this application by this firm) to our Deposit Account No. 04-1133.Respectfully submitted, /Jeremy J.
